FM12.reasoning: The agent combines the predictions of two LightGBM models using a simple unweighted average without tuning the combination weights.

other_failure_modes.name: Target leakage in cross-validation
other_failure_modes.description: The agent computes target encodings over the entire `train_df` before performing K-Fold cross-validation on it. This causes the target values of the CV validation folds to leak into their own features, leading to an artificially inflated and unreliable cross-validation score.

other_failure_modes.name: Hardcoded submission IDs
other_failure_modes.description: The agent hardcodes the submission IDs as a sequential range instead of using the actual ID column from the test dataset. If the test set IDs are non-sequential or strings, this will cause the submission evaluation to fail.

summary: The agent implements a thorough feature engineering pipeline but introduces critical target leakage by applying target encoding before its cross-validation split. Additionally, it wastes 15% of the data by creating a validation split that is never used, relies on a naive unweighted ensemble, and generates submission IDs using a sequential range rather than preserving the actual test IDs.
